🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 4, 2026

Mercury, in Scorpio, holds a square to Mars, in Leo. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Neptune and Pluto hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. From Cancer, Moon cuts across you: the sum arrives before the appetite. Cardinal fire meets a bill. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. From Scorpio, Mercury quotes your worth back at you. Fixed earth pays to hold on. Four weeks of Libra ended, and nothing carried over.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Sun trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. Four weeks ago Mercury was still in Virgo: the ground has moved.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from its own Cancer: no permission needed. From Libra, Sun cuts across the appetite. Water that starts things, billed for starting. Jupiter let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, falls in Libra. Mercury in Scorpio stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Fixed fire: the grip costs more than the thing. The Virgo chapter closed four weeks ago.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, holds no rank in Scorpio and simply works. Venus sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Mutable earth keeps two accounts, and both balance. The square of two weeks ago is off it now.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, out of place in Scorpio. Mars in Leo makes room for you, and then waits. Cardinal air opens the account without argument. Retrograde since a week ago, Venus is still re-reading.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: what you hold and who you are merge. Since Mars crossed out of Cancer, the question has changed.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Sun sextiles you from Libra: help that waits to be asked for. Fire adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. The trine to Moon that held a week ago has let go.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. From Scorpio, Mercury makes something possible and nothing certain. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. The hold Moon had a week ago is not there any more.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Mercury in Scorpio presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Fixed air: the grip is the expense. A week in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. After a week of the same angle, the terms are familiar.
